# trim-newlines [![Build Status](https://example.invalid/sindresorhus/trim-newlines.svg?branch=master)](https://example.invalid/sindresorhus/trim-newlines)

> Trim [newlines](https://example.invalid/wiki/Newline) from the start and/or end of a string


## Install

```
$ npm install --save trim-newlines
```


## Usage

```js
var trimNewlines = require('trim-newlines');

trimNewlines('\nunicorn\r\n');
//=> 'unicorn'
```


## API

### trimNewlines(input)

Trim from the start and end of a string.

### trimNewlines.start(input)

Trim from the start of a string.

### trimNewlines.end(input)

Trim from the end of a string.


## Related

- [trim-left](https://example.invalid/sindresorhus/trim-left) - Similar to `String#trim()` but removes only whitespace on the left
- [trim-right](https://example.invalid/sindresorhus/trim-right) - Similar to `String#trim()` but removes only whitespace on the right.
